rows.en: Can you dodge this?!
You're mine!
All right, attack!
Commencing attack! Here we go!
I'll finish this in one stroke!
To reclaim our pride!
We, the Martian Successors, will not lose!
Fools, daring to defy us!
If I can just sink that ship!
If I hit its Phase Transition Engine...!
rows.notes: Literal 'phase transition reactor'; used glossary Phase Transition Engine.

rows.en: Nadesico! So you stand in our way after all!
Damn that black unit! You'd get in our way?!
That black unit...! I'll catch up to it!
You get in our way yet again!
A space frame... Can it withstand this?!
You traitor! I'll pass judgment on you!
uncertain: 'shodan' = judge and punish; rendered 'pass judgment on you'.. Target is a former Mokuren member who joined the other side (likely Saburota).

rows.en: Siding with the Earthlings? Unforgivable!
Fools who've thrown away Mokuren's pride!
uncertain: Mokuren left untranslated per glossary; 'Jovian' would read clearer to players.

rows.en: I'm only just getting started!
Here's payback!
uncertain: Shared with Giganos soldiers and Ryoma Nagare; 'Here's payback!' works for all.

rows.en: Don't get cocky!
I can't back down like this!
Now I'm coming at you!
uncertain: kocchi could be 'we' or 'I'; chose 'I' (single soldier line).

rows.en: Time to counterattack!
I'm moving to intercept!
Now it's my turn!
I-I have to bail out!!
Gwaah! Is this the end?!
H-how did it come to this?!
Is there no stopping them...?!
We, the Martian Successors...!!
I-I've failed!!
My unit! Uoaaagh!!
J-just like the rumors... No, even worse!
uncertain: 'sore ijou' = beyond the rumors; rendered 'even worse' (from the victim's view), meaning the enemy is stronger than rumored.

rows.en: Th-this is bad! There's nowhere to run!
Guah! Did I take a direct hit?!
Y-you've got to be kidding me!!
Wh-what?! What was that?!
Uooh! I-I can't take any more!!
Am I just going to get taken down like this?!
Wh-what is with their power?!
Uoaaaagh!!
On the pride of the Martian Successors, I can't lose!
The soul of the Jovian forces... will not die...!
rows.notes: Source names the Jovian Alliance forces (Mokuren's military); rendered 'Jovian forces'.
uncertain: 'Mokusei rengougun' rendered 'Jovian forces'; no glossary entry for this exact term.

rows.en: Are you saying we can't win?! Us?!
Grrr...! Beaten by that battleship again!!
D-damn the Nadesico! It's far stronger than before!
Why?! How can we lose to a bunch of clowns like them?!
uncertain: Verb restored as 'lose to'; source only says 'to such clowns'.

rows.en: Th-this is nothing like the old Aestivalis!!
Nngh! I won't flinch!
Don't underestimate our resolve!
Guh! My primary armor?!
Where did it hit?!
I-I can still fight!
I can't be shot down here!
Wh-what?! What was that just now!
D-don't think this will go your way!
I-I somehow managed to hold out
Nngh! They're tough, just as I thought!
S-someone cover me!
That's the Nadesico for you. It's tough!
I can't die until I sink that ship...!
This one...! A clown, but a strong one...!
uncertain: Kept 'This one' (source: koitsu); target gender unknown.

rows.en: The Aestivalis... Has its performance improved?!
The damage is lighter than I thought
Hmph, it's nothing!
I couldn't fully dodge it?!
At least I avoided a direct hit...!
Don't think you can stop us!
This is nothing!
I'll dodge it next time!
You're really underestimating me!
Nngh! Don't get carried away!
If that's all you've got, stay out of this!
Kuh! I can't block it all?!
So this is all the Nadesico amounts to!
Hmph, you're no match for the Nadesico of old!
Being a bit newer won't save you!
Looks like your performance has dropped since the old days!
Evasion successful!
All right! That worked!
Don't think that was luck!
Like I'd take a direct hit!
Hold out for me, shield!
I'll block it all with this!
Come on, work!!
Distortion Field, deploy!
rows.notes: Source uses the kanji form (space-time distortion field); glossary Distortion Field.

rows.en: I'll bounce it right back!
Yes! The Jammer worked!
Missiles won't work on me!
Firing that at me is a waste of time!
Don't think that was a fluke!
Even I can manage this much!
I can't attack?!
Must I just... let them slip past?!
uncertain: Target unknown, used 'them'.

rows.en: I can't counterattack?!
Damn it! I can't lay a finger on them!
Where?! Where did they go?!
Damn, I've lost sight of them!
Did they slip into my blind spot?!
Kuh! Check the relative distance!
Let's keep it going!
Combination attack!
You left an opening!
I can still keep going!
Captain, leave this to me!
uncertain: taichou rendered 'Captain' (squad leader).

rows.en: Now! Fall back!
I'll take care of things here!
You're too far forward!
Hurry up and pull back!
Captain, please fall back!
Prepare for an all-out attack! Here we go!
That one's our target! Everyone, attack together!
Wait for the right timing... Now, go!
I'm counting on you for rear support!
Roger! I'll provide rear support!
Got it! Commencing attack!
I'll provide support fire!
I'm beginning rear support!
Go down!
I've got you now!
I'll riddle you with holes!
You're in range! Take this!
Damn that black unit! You'd get in our way?!
That black unit...! I'll catch up to it!
This is a battle with the future of humanity at stake!
A new world and a new order, in our hands!
We are the Martian Successors!!
All for the sake of a new order!
Now! Behold the dawn of a new order!
Divine punishment--!!
uncertain: 'Tenchuu' (heaven's punishment, a Mokuren rallying cry) rendered 'Divine punishment'.

rows.en: Now we deliver divine punishment!! Fiiire!!
Is this what they call fate...?! But we will not lose!
This time, it is our turn to win!
I will never forget the bitter taste of our past defeat!
What utterly absurd people...! I will wipe them out!
Any obstacle that stands in our way must be eliminated!
Intercept formation! Fiiire!!
We may be evil! But this is a necessary evil!
I will show no mercy!!
...So this is human tenacity...!
How bitter......! Hurry, all hands evacuate!
uncertain: 'Munen' rendered 'How bitter'; ship-abandon line.

rows.en: For our ideals, we cannot back down here!
I will not rot away in a place like this!
Curses...! But at this rate...!
I never imagined their power was this great...! Hurry, check all sections!
Even for a battleship, any more of this is dangerous...!
Do not falter! Prepare to counterattack!
Hmph... So they're concentrating on this ship
No matter! Keep them drawn in on us!
Nngh, a direct hit! Report the damage!!
This battle... we will surely win it...!
There is no need to even evade
Our will cannot be bent!
That will not work on us!
Never mind it! The damage is light!
So we were hit...!
I won't let you have your way so easily!
We will not lose!!
We must keep the damage to a minimum
Truly a victory for our technology!
The Distortion Field still holds!
rows.notes: Source uses the kanji form of Distortion Field.

rows.en: Missiles won't do a thing!
uncertain: Shared with Argo Gulski; neutral wording 'Missiles won't do a thing!' chosen to fit both a ship and a mobile fighter.

rows.en: You underestimated our technology!
So our energy has finally run out...!
Curse you! Such cowardly tricks, to the very end!
Good, we will join the fight as well!
Maximum battle speed! Commence attack!
I cannot let our comrades fall!
I will use this ship as a shield!
The enemy is on the verge of falling! Now, my brave warriors!!
Now we seize victory with our own hands! Forward!
This too is for the sake of humanity's future!
Forgive me...! But it is all for the sake of the new order!!
I'm gonna blast right through you!
If bullets are what you want, I'll give ya plenty!
Quit scurrying around in front of me!
It's my treat! Hang on to it!
uncertain: Ryoko's 'ogori' joke (bullets as a treat); 'It's my treat! Hang on to it!' with implied 'it' = the shot.

rows.en: This range is my range!
All right, time to take out the bad Martians!
Perish, perish, perish! I'll do it myself!
rows.notes: Ryoko mocks the assassins' battle cry 'metsu' (annihilate); rendered 'perish' consistently in rows 180, 194, 203, 211, 358.
uncertain: 'Metsu' chant rendered 'Perish'; a translator may prefer leaving 'Metsu'.

rows.en: Now things are getting a little interesting...!
You! You know what's coming to ya, right?!
I'll give you credit for the guts to come at me!
I pay back triple!
You hit me, I hit back!
Here! That's your change! Keep it!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Kuh! You... You'll pay for this once it's over!
uncertain: Rendered 'You'll pay for this once it's over' for 'remember this when this is over'.

rows.en: ...This time, I might really be in trouble...
That was close, way too close... Dammit...!
Dammit! I ain't going down yet!
Kuuu~! That one really stung...!
Crap! What the hell's up with the field?!
Not yet... It's too soon to say "perish"...!
You Martian bastards... Lookin' down on me!
Ugh!? That did more damage than I thought!
Dammit, have I gotten rusty?!
Me, of all people... How pathetic!
Crap! Did it get through?!
Dammit, the field ain't doing a thing!
I got careless...! But I'm not done yet!
If you're gonna stage a coup, you gotta be at least that good!
Ugh, like I'm gonna perish that easy!
What, is that all you've got?!
uncertain: Shared with Koji Kabuto; wording works for both.

rows.en: You ain't got enough guts!
Whoa! Did I get rattled a little?
uncertain: 'chito yureta ka' could mean the unit shook or the attack barely rocked her; chose 'Did I get rattled a little?'.

rows.en: Keep 'em coming!
Is that really all you've got?!
You makin' fun of me?!
If that's all you've got, forget the coup!
Shut up with all your "perish" and "slash" crap!
Heh, way too slow!
You underestimating me, punk?!
I ain't lettin' that hit me!
What a sluggish attack!
Lousy shot!
Get lost and don't come back!
uncertain: Shared with Nana Izumi and Kyoshiro Yuzuki; idiom 'come back the day before yesterday' rendered 'Get lost and don't come back!'.

rows.en: If you wanna hit my Aestivalis, aim better!
rows.notes: Ryoko says 'Este' (short for Aestivalis); full name used.

rows.en: Heh, it'd be harder to actually get hit by that!
I can't stand that smirking face of yours!
Gekigan Barrier! Heh, that takes me back
Distortion Field, full power!
Field at maximum output!
I've got a field, y'know!
Tch~! Oh, come on! I'm outta ammo?!
Come at me fair and square!
Hey, butt out! That one's mine!
Outta my way! Just shut up and watch!
I'm still here, y'know!
Hey! Quit screwing around and make room!
Gettin' rusty?! You didn't finish it off!
uncertain: Shared with Saburota; addressed to an ally who failed to finish a target ('blank' = rust from time off).

rows.en: Ruri! I'm going! Move!
Being captain ain't easy, huh, Ruri
uncertain: Ryoko speaking to Ruri as captain of the Nadesico B.

rows.en: Akito! Leave the rest to me!
You've gotten better, Akito!
I won't let you!
Not while I'm still around!
Tch, don't make me babysit you!
Ora ora ora! I'm gonna shoot you down!
I'm gonna shoot you down good and proper!
Swiss cheese time! Rapid Rifle!
You're in my rifle's range!
This one's gonna hurt! Rail Cannon!
I'm blowin' right past you!
You left your body unguarded!
I said your body's wide open!
Distortion Field, full power! All riiight!
My Aestivalis is stronger up close!
I won't lose in close combat!
In a slugfest, I win!
Heh, things are about to get rough, huh!
Old skills never fade, y'know!
Nice distance we've got here, huh?
Guess I'll put in some solid work!
I feel bad attacking my old buddies, but still!
So it was you?! You messed with the Captain!
uncertain: taichou = Ryoko (Saburota's squad leader), rendered 'Captain'.

rows.en: You don't think you'll get off free, do ya?!
I, Saburota Takasugi, won't run or hide!
You've got guts! But guts alone won't win!
I hold grudges longer than you'd think, y'know?
I may not look it, but I'm a loyal guy!
Lay a hand on me and you won't walk away in one piece!
So this is it...?! Pathetic...!
Whoa! What the hell is with this one?!
uncertain: Enemy gender unknown; 'this one'.

rows.en: Keep this up and I'm done for!
Damn it! Me, of all people!
Crap, at this rate I'm gonna get blown away!
Hang in there a bit longer for me, Aesti-chan!
rows.notes: 'Este-chan': Saburota's pet name for his Aestivalis, rendered Aesti-chan.
uncertain: 'Aesti-chan' keeps the honorific; consider 'Aesti baby' if honorifics are avoided.

rows.en: The field's useless?!
I won't stand for some coup...!!
It ain't over yet! You assassin!
Whoa?! Yikes, that one really hit
Gwah! Not good!
Guh...! That hurts more than I thought...!
The Aesti's soft, y'know! Go easy on her!
Hey hey, is the field even working?!
Is this all the Aestivalis's armor can take?!
A coup with this kind of power. I see
Assassin punk, don't get cocky!
Whoa there! Yikes, yikes...
Wha?! I let her get scratched...!
uncertain: Inferred he is talking about his own Aestivalis being scratched; 'her' = the Aesti.

rows.en: Whoa?! ...Well, would ya look at that
Oops? Sorry about that, Aesti-chan
Did that slip through the field a bit?
You scratched my Aesti!
Oh, that got through? Ha, makes a colleague proud
uncertain: Unclear: hit by a former Mokuren comrade? Rendered 'makes a colleague proud'; source says 'colleague', not 'former colleague'.

rows.en: You're not actually that tough, are ya, pal?
I'm not a custom job for nothing!
Mobility is the Aestivalis's lifeblood!
Hup! Easy-peasy!
Whoa-ho-ho! Way too sloppy!
Trying to hit the great Saburota, huh?
Hup, hup!
Stuff like that ain't gonna hit me
I ain't getting hit by an old colleague!
Quit wasting your time already!
I can't let my Aesti-chan get all scuffed up!
Is that all you've got, Mr. Assassin?!
uncertain: 'Koroshiya-san' rendered 'Mr. Assassin'; the assassins (Hokushin's men) are male in the film.

rows.en: Gekigan Barrier! Heh, that takes me back
Well, well, I'm all out of moves
Attacking from way over there won't do much
uncertain: Source trails ('being attacked from there, well...'); completed as 'won't do much'.

rows.en: Saburota Takasugi has arrived~!
Okay, okay, I'll jump in and back you up~!
Whoa, I'll just hop on this one!
Yesterday's enemy is today's friend, so let's get along!
Captaaain~! Saburota Takasugi's on his way!
How about a rendezvous attack?!
uncertain: 'Rendezvous Attack' is a combo name; no glossary entry. Check akurasu.

rows.en: Whoa there! This is bad
Pretty devoted, ain't I?
We'll call this one a favor you owe me!
Let's pick 'em off!
Well then, let's let 'em have it
Let's go at 'em in one fell swoop!
I'm gonna shoot like crazy!
Guess I'll fire away to my heart's content!
I'll let you off with being Swiss cheese!
I'm shooting! My mind's made up!
Let's go out with a big bang!
Move if you don't wanna get blasted through!
Sorry, I may not look it, but I'm a crack shot!
My ace in the hole, the Rail Cannon! Let's try it!
I'll take you down with the Rail Cannon!
Let's have ourselves some fun up close!
Field, full power! Here I go, all at once!
Distortion Field, full poweeer!
I'm not half bad at close combat, y'know?
Geeekigan! Flaaaare!!
Close, close! Here I go!
Anyone who gets close gets punched out!
You got too close, pal!
Brings back memories~! Gekigan Flare!
...You're going down...
...Don't get in my way
You're an eyesore...
Disappear
...Shatter
I have the edge in mobility
I'm making my move...
I won't let you evade
You... I'll take you down with my own hands
uncertain: Akito voice set also used by '???' (masked Akito); lines fit both.

rows.en: I will never... forgive you
Cursed band of assassins... I'll crush your leader...
uncertain: Source 'crush the head' read as taking out the group's leader (Hokushin); rendered 'crush your leader'.

rows.en: If you get in my way... I'll shoot you down
I don't have time to deal with you...
Get lost
I can't hold back like I used to...
...Intercepting
I'll be counterattacking
Intercept program... activate
Lapis... I'm counting on you... to retrieve me...
uncertain: Akito asking Lapis to recover him (ejection/retrieval).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
To fail this badly...
It still moves... at least
I won't let it end like this...!
uncertain: Subject ambiguous (it/I); chose 'I won't let it end like this'.

rows.en: Damage check... Not even worth doing. Ngh...
...You'll pay for this
Not yet... I'm still alive... Come, assassin
Who will perish, me... or you...!
It got through the field...?
Field generator, check
Kuh!? Damn it...!
It seems you're quite skilled...
You seem to have some skill
It pierced the field...?! But I won't lose to you
Our fight... is only just beginning
Tch...
Minor damage...
...Nothing to worry about
Armor damaged...
It's nothing
What's wrong... Is that all you've got? Assassin
Don't talk big with only this much
I don't even need to rely on the field
Evading, then intercepting
That won't hit me
Heh heh heh...
...Aim for real
I won't let that hit me
Evasive maneuver, complete...
Distortion Field... deploying
The field can block this much
Field output stable
Evasion program...!
I was careless...
Hit from my blind spot... A blunder...
Clear the way
...I'll provide support
Continuing the attack
Ryoko-chan, fall back
uncertain: Akito uses -chan for Ryoko, Hikaru, Ruri; kept honorific (matches existing dialogue 'Ryoko-chan').

rows.en: You haven't changed, have you...
uncertain: Addressee not certain (probably Ryoko).

rows.en: Hikaru-chan, I'll attack from my side too
...I'll move to cover the Nadesico directly
Ruri-chan... don't push yourself
If you're going to slow me down, fall back
...Fall back while you can
I'll hold them off. Fall back
I'll end it here...
...Making my move
Field, full power...!
Distortion Field, maximum output...!
Maximum battle speed... Can you dodge this...!
Field output stable... Making my move...!
Distortion Attack... Let's settle this!
This will settle it... Deploying the field at maximum output
Target, locked
uncertain: 'Target, lock' rendered 'Target, locked'.

rows.en: You're in range...
I'll shoot you down
...You've entered my line of fire
